decisions.reason: roles.secondary: a candidate is a role whose requires the unit meets and whose description fits a sourced part; it ranks at the first step that supports it, and inside a step the order of the roles list decides. Support needs a repair tool or the repair-allies or resupply-allies pattern; abilities/2 (an innate button) now links resupply-allies, so the requires are met, and the description (resupplies teammates) fits the sourced refill (cached Ability page: Consecrated Restocking gives back all missing ammo when Consecration lands; Vimana page: a Sacrifice or another Vimana's Benediction sets it off). Buffer (no requires) fits the timed damage cut and speed boost. Both rank at step 2; the roles list puts support (8th) before buffer (14th). Anti-infantry (splash, step 3) and scout (detector, step 4) come after. Step 1 gives nothing: the official line (2.0.0 Veti notes and the Celestial Gate production box) says it gives off an aura of Subjugation; aura is half of the Buffer / aura label, but this aura works on enemies, so it does not describe the buffer job (a literal reading would rank buffer first; the uncertain entry could say in one clause why it does not). roles.primary stays assault: the designation Aerial Subjugation Fortress names no role, the cannon does damage so step 2 never applies, it is a medium-reach beam (no siege or marksman), it has no bonus, and step 5 gives assault (slow, super-heavy). The validator reports no error.

Matchups rule (3): a unit: link sits next to a word-list or pattern link for the same reason. combos/4 is pattern:resupply-allies (added in commit 3618824) with the sourced reason (an Enlightened's Sacrifice sets off Consecrated Restocking and refills the cannon; Vimana page), and combos/5 is unit:tempest-rising.veti.enlightened with 'The same reason'. The clause finding 7 found false ('no word-list or pattern link names the Veti's Sacrifice') is gone (git show bb7e92b vs HEAD). By rule (1) the link names what the partner brings: the refill, which resupply-allies names and which also holds for a second Vimana's Benediction (abilities/6 summary; Vimana page); sacrifice-for-allies would only add the spent life. Nothing to add.

modes/0/via is right: modes[].via is 'the pattern that switches to this mode', the bunker is entered only through the second life that fortify-on-death names, and the validator counts via for source_units (scripts/validate.mjs line 718). Keeping passenger-sets-weapon on abilities/1 is not: the Pattern links convention links a second pattern only when it passes the test on its own. passenger-sets-weapon's summary is a vehicle whose weapon or job comes from its riders; on the bus that is abilities/0 (Firing ports), which links it. abilities/1 is the second life (lethal blow, fixed bunker with fresh health, riders fight on), which is fortify-on-death's summary; the fortify-on-death file treats the two as different interactions (related kind combos-with) and asks to retire passenger-sets-weapon's wreck-bunker twist (open_questions/5); passenger-sets-weapon's generator kinds are passive only, while abilities/1 is triggered. Group 3's writer asked for this removal (open point 3a). The same stand-in remains in strengths/3 and weaknesses/1, whose reasons are the bunker second life but whose ref is still pattern:passenger-sets-weapon; Matchups says to pick the link that names the part behind the reason.

decisions.reason: The registry line for deploy-turret now reads 'Place an automatic turret or device that fights on its own, or one that heals, repairs or resupplies allies near it.', and the Repair Turret line in games-r3.md is the group 6 fixer's option (a) text word for word, so the link passes the pattern-link test. Roles: deploy-turret is in category summon, so area-denial's requires are met through an innate button (step 2), but its description (controls ground with mines, fire, turrets or fortifications) does not fit, and the tie-break 'Engineer / builder or Area denial or Support' gives turrets that block or guard ground to area denial and repairing to support; the Repair Turret does no fighting. dampen-missile-fire (control) meets disabler's requires, but the Missile Interference Aura is an always-on passive, and no roles.secondary step (official text, button or mode, weapons, speed/armour/senses, passengers/upgrades/doctrines/options) ranks a passive. The slots stay support (step 2) and scout (step 5).

The validator reads requires from each linked pattern's main category only (scripts/validate.mjs line 446; fields.md: also_in is for filtering). New requires met: command-companion (summon) gives area-denial to Anna Kos and Olga Morozova, but a bear or tiger partner controls no ground with mines, fire, turrets or fortifications, so the description fails (and Olga's entry is triggered, which no step ranks). block-abilities (control) gives disabler to the Sentinel, but EM Interference is a doctrine (step 5) and both slots hold step 1 or step 3 roles. stack-to-overload (control) changes nothing: the Voltaic Cannon already met disabler through its silence trait and disable-machine, and disabler is already its first secondary. Mason already met area-denial through Deploy Exosuit. join-ally-crew (transport-garrison), fortify-on-death and retaliate-on-hit (defence), build-structure, generate-income, band-together and sacrifice-for-allies (support), convert-on-kill and heal-from-debuff (conversion) and rage-when-wounded (weapon-behaviour) feed no role's requires; roles without requires were open before, and the new passive or triggered entries (Horde bonus, Berserk, Arcing, Tempest Plating) are ranked by no step. Roles as they stand: Anna anti-infantry; support, disabler. Olga assault; anti-infantry, scout. Sentinel scout; anti-infantry, anti-air. Line Officer assault; buffer, anti-infantry. decisions.reason: No written rule is broken today. fields.md allows related[].kind variant-of, and status proposed means written but not yet reviewed and calibrated; a later fold is recorded with status merged and merged_into, which the validator supports. A fold needs freeze-and-shatter.json changed, an existing file whose review status is checked, and the Pattern links convention says never to edit an existing pattern file. Granularity (same interaction and counterplay = one pattern) argues for the fold, and the stack-to-overload summary itself now says it is a variant of freeze-and-shatter, so it is rightly a decision for the owner. If he folds it, the Voltaic Tank's armament/0 and combos/0 links and the games-r3.md sentence 'Both sides of that link stack-to-overload' must move to freeze-and-shatter.
